# Third-party components

- EasyX Graphics Library 26.10.25, official download: https://easyx.cn/download/EasyX_26.10.25.exe
  Website and copyright information: https://easyx.cn/copyright
  The original download and supplied readme are retained under third_party/easyx.
  The application uses the official MinGW MSVCRT x64 Unicode static library.
  EasyX binaries are third-party components; no EasyX source ownership is claimed.
- cJSON 1.7.19, https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/v1.7.19
  MIT license, retained in third_party/cjson/LICENSE.
- The supplied songs, WAV files and charts are copied from the original NoteCollision
  project. Their provenance is described in each song's README.md.
